title: External identifier formats
description: For each kind of entity, the external identifier namespaces it takes, the form a stored value has, how an entered value is normalized, and the page a value links to (docs/design/catalog.md, External identifiers).

pattern.description: Anchored regular expression a normalized value matches.

normalize.description: Applied in order after trimming: remove-separators drops spaces and hyphens; upper-case and lower-case change case.

link.description: Page for a value; {value} is replaced by the encoded value.
